description: Return the baseline, current, and diff images for one changed snapshot so you can see what changed visually: the full page downscaled to fit (it shows where the changes are), then, when it had to be downscaled, each changed region cropped at native scale with 32 px around it and as wide as the page (up to 1280 px), so you can read text, wrapping and clipping there (up to 3 crops, each at most 1280×1024 px and 2,000,000 px in all; nearby regions share a crop, changes come before shifts, a wider area is sampled at 1/2 scale or smaller, and a taller one shows its top rows). Pass `region` (an index the response lists) for another region, or `y` and `height` for any band of the page: those return only that crop; for a missing baseline (no capture this run), only the committed baseline image, since there is no current capture. Use get_report / get_visual_results first to find snapshot names.

height.description: Rows of the band from y (default: what one crop shows, 1024 at native scale); a taller band shows its top rows and says where to continue

region.description: Index of one of the snapshot's regions, as get_diff lists them (results.json order): returns only that region, cropped at native scale

y.description: Top of a full-width band of the page, in pixels: returns only that band, at native scale

name: get_snapshot_diff
title: View snapshot diff images
